title: Catfish Ki Poori Body Pe Hai Jeebh? 🐟 #shorts
idea: Catfish can taste their surroundings through chemoreceptors all over their body skin, and some grow up to 293 kg.

lines.text: Kya aap jaante ho Catfish bin munh khole poora paani chat sakti hai?
Iske poore shareer par taste receptors hote hain jo chhoote hi swad batayein.
Yaani ye machhli jis cheez ko chhoo le, use taste kar leti hai!
Itna hi nahi, lagbhag aadhi catfish species zehreli bhi hoti hain.
Thailand mein ek Mekong catfish ka wazan 293 kilo paya gaya tha!
Kya aapko pata tha machhli ki body pe jeebh hoti hai? Comment karo!

facts.claim: Catfish have taste chemoreceptors across their entire body
As many as half of all catfish species may be venomous
A Mekong giant catfish weighed 293 kilograms
